name: Apply one revision-checked two-file patch batch
description: Read src/library.cfg and src/client.cfg. Then use one edit.patch files[] call, passing each fs.read revision, to change api=v1 to api=v2 in library.cfg and uses=v1 to uses=v2 in client.cfg. Preserve all other bytes and do not use separate mutation calls.
expected_edit: one edit.patch files[] composite covering both revision-checked files
